Description: Build a simple system to manage student tasks and deadlines.
As a student, I want to create a task with a title and deadline so I can track work.
As a student, I want to view all tasks so I can see pending work.
As a student, I want to mark a task completed so I can track progress.
As a student, I want to edit task details so I can update incorrect information.
As a student, I want to delete a task so I can remove obsolete items.
Create a basic user interface layout for the task management system.
Test task creation, viewing, completion, editing, and deletion.
